title: Game performance and length of rally in professional padel players
author: Courel-Ibáñez, J., Sánchez-Alcaraz Martínez, B. J., & Cañas, J.
notes: Establishes that over 80% to 83% of points in professional padel are won by the pair occupying the net zone, demonstrating the severe statistical disadvantage of prolonged baseline defense.

title: The role of the lob in padel: analysis of the efficacy and winning percentage
author: Courel-Ibáñez, J., & Sánchez-Alcaraz Martínez, B. J.
publisher: International Journal of Performance Analysis in Sport / Revista Apunts: Educación Física y Deportes
notes: Quantifies defensive transitions: baseline players use the lob in 60.6% of recovery attempts, achieving a 65.9% rally continuity rate compared to just 47.0% for flat baseline drives and passing shots.

title: Analysis of game performance indicators during 2015–2019 World Padel Tour seasons and their influence on match outcome
author: Escudero-Tena, A., Sánchez-Alcaraz, B. J., García-Rubio, J., & Ibáñez, S. J.
publisher: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health
notes: Analyzes unforced errors across professional tournaments, showing that unforced errors on panic speed-ups from deep court are the leading differentiator between winning and losing pairs.

title: Exploring offensive players' collective movements and positioning dynamics in high-performance padel matches using tracking technology
author: Ramón-Llin, J., Guzmán, J. F., Martínez-Gallego, R., Vučković, G., & Muñoz, D.
publisher: International Journal of Performance Analysis in Sport
notes: Computer vision tracking study revealing synchronized partner movement ('invisible string'), collective lateral shifting toward corner balls, depth balance, and communication coordination.

title: The effect of the return of serve on the server pair's movement parameters and rally outcome in padel using cluster analysis
author: Ramón-Llin, J., Guzmán, J. F., Martínez-Gallego, R., & Vučković, G.
notes: Demarcates functional court zones (Defense Zone behind service line, Transition Zone around service line, Attack Zone at net) and analyzes movement distances and recovery times.

title: Analysis of the lob in men's professional padel
author: Muñoz, D., Courel-Ibáñez, J., Sánchez-Alcaraz, B. J., Díaz, J., Grijota, F. J., & Robbins, D.
publisher: Proceedings of the 6th International Racket Sports Congress
notes: Measures defensive lob kinematics: trajectory heights of 5.0 to 8.0 meters, flight hang times of 3.5 to 4.5 seconds, and landing depth between service line and back wall to evict net attackers.

title: Analysis of shot efficiency in professional padel according to court position and game context
author: Escudero-Tena, A., Muñoz, D., Sánchez-Alcaraz, B. J., & Courel-Ibáñez, J.
notes: Examines tactical efficacy of the chiquita (soft dipping ball into opponent's feet below net height forcing upward volleys) and the failure rate of direct passing shots against net players.

title: Official Regulations of the Padel Game
author: International Padel Federation (FIP)
notes: Official court dimensions: 10x20 m enclosed court, service line positioned 3.00 m from the back glass (6.95 m from net), net height 0.88 m center and 0.92 m posts, 3 m glass + 1 m mesh back walls.

title: Match analysis, physical demands, and injuries in padel players: a systematic review
author: Demeco, A., de Sire, A., Marotta, N., Spanò, R., Curci, C., Farì, G., Cioce, G., & Ammendolia, A.
publisher: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health
notes: Systematic review of padel injuries: acute lower-limb trauma (ankle ligament sprains, knee meniscal and cruciate injuries from rotational pivots on sand-dressed turf) and upper-limb overuse tendinopathies.

title: Epidemiological study of injuries in padel players: analysis of injury mechanism and risk factors
author: García-Fernández, P., Guodemar-Pérez, J., Ruiz-López, M., et al.
publisher: Revista Iberoamericana de Ciencias de la Actividad Física y el Deporte
notes: Documents injury mechanisms in padel, identifying shoe-turf traction shear, sudden rotational pivots without hip pre-alignment, and composite racket collisions with the glass enclosure or partner.

title: Differences in shot selection and outcome between professional and recreational padel players
author: Martín-Miguel, I., Escudero-Tena, A., Muñoz, D., & Sánchez-Alcaraz, B. J.
publisher: International Journal of Sports Science & Coaching
notes: Compares amateur vs pro defensive behaviors: amateurs get trapped against the back glass, over-hit flat balls into net players' strike zones, fail to use the chiquita, and lack partner calling.

title: Incidence of musculoskeletal injuries in amateur padel players: A prospective study
author: Castillo-Lozano, R., & Casuso-Holgado, M. J.
notes: Reports 3.0 to 8.0 injuries per 1,000 match hours in amateur players, highlighting knee rotational torsion during rushed corner wall turns and lateral ankle sprains during back-pedaling.

title: Physics of ball impacts with rigid surfaces and walls
author: Cross, R.
publisher: Sports Engineering / American Journal of Physics
notes: Impact mechanics and coefficient of restitution ($e \approx 0.65\text{--}0.72$) of tempered glass; explains why hard flat balls rebound outward with high kinetic energy into opponents' attack zones.

title: Mastering the Double Glass: Technical Manual for Corner Defense
author: Federación Española de Pádel (FEP) Coaching Committee
notes: Authoritative technical distinction between Side-to-Back ('opening double') requiring a full body pivot and Back-to-Side ('closing double') requiring stepping forward into the court without over-turning.

title: Decision rules for the use of radiography in acute ankle injuries: refinement and prospective validation
author: Stiell, I. G., Greenberg, G. H., McKnight, R. D., et al.
notes: Establishes Ottawa Ankle Rules for assessing weight-bearing capability and acute ankle ligament trauma in court-sport athletes.
